_comment: Registry of local businesses that get Google-Business-Profile-ONLY posts.
Adding a new business = add one object here + its URL queue file + its
location name (either its own GitHub Secret named in `location_env`, or
an entry keyed by `id` inside the GBP_LOCATIONS_JSON secret).
No new OAuth is needed: the SAME GBP_REFRESH_TOKEN works for every
listing your Google account owns OR manages, because the
business.manage scope is account-wide, not location-wide.
Fields:
id                  - short slug, used for the posting log + image folder
site                - the business's own domain; queue URLs off it are ignored
primary_category    - exactly as it reads on the Business Profile
focus               - the only services this listing may talk about
never_mention       - services that belong to another listing, or aren't offered
enabled             - false skips the business entirely
name                - real business name (used in the copy prompts)
industry / city     - grounding context for Claude's copy + photo prompt
queue_file          - text file of that site's URLs, one per line
location_env        - env/secret name holding accounts/<id>/locations/<id>
or just the numeric Business Profile ID (the one
under Advanced settings on the profile) — the code
looks up which account holds it. Same for the
values inside the GBP_LOCATIONS_JSON secret.
image_mode          - photo (default) | flux | template
photo = the promoted page's OWN photograph with the
headline over it, rotating three overlay
layouts (centred / frosted band / split)
flux  = same layouts over a generated Replicate photo
template = flat icon cards, no photo (fallback look)
image_mode_env      - optional secret name that overrides image_mode
posts_per_month     - cap per 30-day period (default 10)
min_days_between_posts - minimum spacing between posts (default 3)
posting_offset      - which day of the rota this listing starts on, so
the listings don't all post on the same days.
Defaults to its position in this list, which
spreads a newly added business automatically.
fallback_image      - a photo URL to use when a page has none of its own
brand               - colours + wording baked into the card templates
photo_scene         - the setting FLUX should place the tradesperson in
